head.title: Yaroslav S. - Middle Go Developer
head.description: Backend developer with  commercial Go experience building microservices and REST/gRPC APIs with PostgreSQL, Redis and Kafka. Experience with high-load order processing, idempotent event handling, query optimization, Kubernetes and observability.

aboutMe.title: Middle Go Developer
aboutMe.text: Backend developer with {{experience}} years of commercial Go development. I build microservices and REST APIs with net/http and work with PostgreSQL, Redis and Kafka. Took part in developing an AI API Gateway: implemented LLM response streaming, Redis-based rate limiting and token accounting via Kafka. I take tasks from design all the way to production: I write tests, set up metrics and alerts, and investigate incidents. I know how to find bottlenecks with pprof and EXPLAIN ANALYZE.

info.title: Uzum
list: Worked on a marketplace system covering the order and seller services
Developed and maintained order-processing microservices in Go (net/http, gRPC)
Developed Kafka consumers and producers for order, payment and delivery status events
Designed schemas and optimized queries in PostgreSQL, wrote migrations
Cached catalog and product card data in Redis
Wrote unit and integration tests (table-driven, testcontainers), conducted code reviews
Deployed services to Kubernetes via GitLab CI, set up metrics and alerts in Prometheus and Grafana
achievements: Made order event processing idempotent (deduplication keys, DLQ with retries): duplicates on message redelivery dropped to zero, manual incident investigations were reduced by 70%
Sped up the seller order history endpoint using EXPLAIN ANALYZE, composite indexes and cursor pagination: p95 dropped from 600 to 90 ms
Set up graceful shutdown and readiness probes, eliminating 5xx errors during deployments

info.title: Fabros
list: Developed backend services for classified ads and paid promotion services in Go
Developed REST APIs for web and mobile clients, authorization and logging middleware
Worked with PostgreSQL and Redis: transactions, indexes, caching of popular listings
Implemented asynchronous processing of ad events via Kafka (moderation, publication, renewal)
Covered code with tests, took part in code reviews and task planning
Containerized services (Docker, multi-stage builds) and maintained CI pipelines
achievements: Implemented idempotent payment charging for paid services (idempotency key, transactions): eliminated double charges on client network retries
Introduced Redis-based rate limiting for the public API, reducing load from bots and scrapers by 40%
Moved the search results cache to Redis using the cache-aside pattern with TTL: PostgreSQL load decreased by 35%, API response time went from 300 to 70 ms
Reduced Docker image size from 800 to 30 MB with multi-stage builds, making CI builds 2x faster

info.title: MDigital
list: Developed REST APIs in Go (net/http, chi), implemented error handling and data validation
Worked with PostgreSQL: queries, JOINs, indexes, migrations (golang-migrate)
Integrated third-party APIs: payment systems and SMS gateways
Wrote unit tests, set up the local environment with Docker Compose
achievements: Built a notification service (SMS, email) with retries and exponential backoff, raising deliverability to 98%
Increased test coverage of my module from 30% to 75%
